introduction.heading: Plumbing for Murray homes
introduction.body:
Half of the homes in Murray were built in 1978 or later, and about 54% before 1980, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. Older homes like these often need work on main water lines, drains and fixtures, along with the water heater.

Murray runs its own water system from 19 deep wells and 8 springs, including McGhie Springs near Big Cottonwood Canyon. Some parts of Murray are served by other providers instead. Hardness averaged 194 mg/L (11.4 grains per gallon), according to Murray's 2025 water quality report. The U.S. Geological Survey classes that as very hard water. Hard water leaves mineral deposits in water heaters, faucets and appliances, and a water softener or filtration system cuts that buildup.

Murray's system includes 198 miles of water line and 12 million gallons of storage, according to its 2025 report.
